permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Voice to Groq; questions and Google Search via Gemini; weather (Open-Meteo); rates (er-api); maps (Esri/OSM); places (Photon, Nominatim); walking routes (OSRM); transit (Transitous); scores (ESPN); crypto (CoinGecko); facts (Wikipedia, DuckDuckGo); your Google Calendar via your own Apps Script.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Records from the glasses microphones while you talk to EDITH, for live captions and meeting notes, and, if you turn on hands-free, to listen for "Hey EDITH".

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Shows where you are on the map, finds nearby places, gives walking directions, tracks walks and runs, finds nearby transit, and gives local weather.
